name: FAQ empty state
purpose: Keep the FAQ slot and its heading on feature pages whose CMS FAQ list is empty, showing a single 'no FAQs' bar instead of an accordion.
retrievalReason: CMS empty state ('No FAQs found.') rendered only when a feature page's FAQ list is empty; no retrievable content, never a block a generator should choose.
description: Page-local CMS empty state of the feature-page FAQ (data-section 'faq', data-variant 'empty'): padding 5rem / 4rem tab / 3rem mob, a centred serif H2 (60rem max) and, 4.375rem below, a single 42rem-wide surface-1 bar with the message 'No FAQs found.' in body text. No accordion, no interaction. Rendered by FeatureDetail in place of the FAQ when the route's data has `empty: true`.

heading.measuredLongestRealInstance: 3 words in the clone's own placeholder copy

message.note: Empty-state line in the bar (hard-coded 'No FAQs found.').
